name: kefyusuf/laravel-guarded-tools
description: Guarded tools and assurance tests for Laravel AI agents: workspace isolation, honest failures and evidence on every tool call.

suggest.laravel/ai: For tools on plain laravel/ai (GuardedTools\Ai\GuardedTool); 1.0 or newer. packstub/agents installs it too.
suggest.packstub/agents: For tools on packstub/agents (GuardedTools\Packstub\GuardedAgentTool); 1.7.1 or newer.
suggest.neuron-core/neuron-ai: For tools on Neuron AI inside a Laravel app (GuardedTools\Neuron\GuardedNeuronTool); 4.1 or newer.
suggest.prism-php/prism: For read tools on Prism (GuardedTools\Prism\GuardedPrismTool); 0.100 or newer.
